label: Every essential truth about a being holds at every point where it is absent
paraphrase: OPEN (existence-conditional essentialism, Fine/Lowe reading; analyst formulation): for every being x and world-proposition phi, if it lies in the nature of x that phi, then phi holds at every point of the frame's world type at which x does not exist: x's essential truths have the form 'if x exists, ...'.
